subject: Forecast sanity check: BrightWave Q3 commit accuracy
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast sanity check: BrightWave Q3 commit accuracy

Team —

Quick ask as we lock Q3 commit: Finance flagged a couple of BrightWave rows where amount/SKU/next step/probability look inconsistent with our current notes. I pulled an extract (attached) showing the current CRM values; highlight rows 4, 7, 12. Specific asks: 

- Confirm contract amount (ARR) vs. committed ARR in notes — some rows show $0 or blank.
- Verify product/SKU: multiple opportunities are listed as "Platform - Unknown SKU". Replace with correct SKU (e.g., INFERENCE-1 or INF-ENTERPRISE).
- Update Next Step and Forecast Probability to reflect the most recent sales activity (do not leave as the default 10%/0).
- Add a single-line rationale in the notes field when you change probability. Finance needs traceability for the commit.

Please update the export and reply with the corrected CSV by EOD today so revenue can finalize the commit. If you need me to reach out to the customer to get a signed note for the amount change, I can do that — but let's first get CRM accurate.

Attachment: BrightWave-oppty-extract.csv (CSV; 18 rows)

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast sanity check: BrightWave Q3 commit accuracy

Thanks Logan — I pulled the extract and started validating rows. Quick notes inline: 

- Row 4 (BW-OPP-113): Customer verbally committed to a 3-node cluster; CRM had $0. Confirmed ARR should be $120,000. I added note: "Confirmed during 4/22 call — legal review in progress." Updated probability from 50% to 75%.
- Row 7 (BW-OPP-117): Product listed as "Platform - Unknown SKU"; sales told me this is INF-ENTERPRISE. Changed SKU and set next step to "Send SOW for signature".
- Row 12 (BW-OPP-121): Still in discovery; left amount blank but set probability to 15% and next step to "Product deep-dive (scheduled)".

I attached a cleaned CSV with our annotations. I did not change any closed/won records. Took care to add a one-line rationale where probability changed.

Attachment: FW_BW_adjusted_rows.csv (CSV; 6 updated rows)

Marissa
Account Executive, Sales
Redwood Inference

Nice work Marissa — tagging my updates for ops/finance ingestion. I merged the CSV rows into the canonical extract and made the following operational changes before handing up to Finance: 

- Normalized SKUs to our product table: INF-ENTERPRISE -> INF-E; INFERENCE-1 -> INF-S; updated product_id fields.
- Standardized currency to USD, converted two entries that were in EUR.
- Added a _commit_reason field (short code) to indicate source: CALL, EMAIL_CONFIRM, SOW, LEGAL_SIGNED.

Deliverables: merged file attached (FW_BW_adjusted_rows.csv) and an Ops note in the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4571

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.

A couple of follow-ups before I close the commit for finance: 

1) Marissa — please confirm whether BW-OPP-113 has an email thread from the customer that matches the $120k number. If not, please schedule the follow-up with Julie and copy Finance on the confirmation.
2) Ben — thanks for the normalization. Finance prefers the commit_reason codes, please also add the CRM field "commit_source" with the HubSpot activity id for traceability.

If we can get the final CSV and (if needed) a one-line customer confirmation by EOD tomorrow, I will mark these as "Finance Commit" for Q3. Otherwise we'll reclassify to "Best Case".

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales Operations
